_provenance.what: GATE-4-SPECIFIC per-fix sigma, recalibrated to the L3 at-speed shadow gate-4 rows.
_provenance.at_speed_caveat: L3 is ~17-18 m/s (inc7). The BINDING gate-4 is ~30 m/s (doctrine) / older 37 m/s. Motion-blur sigma at 30-37 m/s is UNMEASURED -- a standing caveat, gated on the held inc8 envelope-relaxed policy. Do NOT claim the 0.10 holds at 30+ m/s.

lateral.label: lateral_inplane_gateX
lateral.note: crab-coupled (corr |cross| vs crab +0.25) -> the NOISY in-plane axis at this high-crab gate.

vertical.label: vertical_inplane_gateY
vertical.note: the BORESIGHT axis. bias_band -0.215 m is epsilon_vert (gate-DOWN) that the -0.25 m bake removes; post-bake the mean->~0 and the per-fix scatter is the clean 0.10.

depth.label: depth_along
depth.note: L3 gate-4 along sd; LOOSE by design (engine ME uses RADIAL_SIGMA 0.5; the absolute fix + IMU own depth).

inplane_isotropic_for_margin.formula: sqrt((lateral_floor^2 + vertical_floor^2)/2)  -- in-plane-radial-equivalent for the single-sigma ME.fly_lap engine

note: sigma(range)=max(floor,a1*range); a1=0 (range-flat over the 20-24 m gate-4 operating band). GATE-4 SPECIFIC -- do NOT use for other gates (anisotropy is posture/crab-dependent).
